test_title: PYST 45: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 06 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Marks of two candidates J and K are the in ratio of 15 ∶ 17. If the marks of J are 300, then what will be the marks of K?
solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of marks of J and K = 15 ∶ 17

Marks of J = 300

**Formula used:**

Let the marks of K be x.

According to the ratio, 15/17 = 300/x

**Calculations:**

15/17 = 300/x

⇒ 15x = 17 × 300

⇒ 15x = 5100

⇒ x = 5100 / 15

⇒ x = 340

**∴ The marks of K are 340.**
